title: UCI 360 Air Quality (gas multisensor and reference analyzer, one unnamed Italian city, 2004-2005)
summary: Hourly averaged readings (9,357 rows in the CSV; UCI states 9,358 instances) from a road-level air-quality multisensor device in an unnamed Italian city, paired with co-located certified reference analyzer values for CO, NMHC, benzene, NOx and NO2, plus temperature, relative humidity and absolute humidity. The sample covers the whole file, with dates from 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04. It is a research sensor-calibration dataset, not a city monitoring-network feed: it has no traffic counts, no clinic data and no station identifier. Missing values are coded as -200.

quality_notes: LICENCE CONFLICT: the UCI licence block says CC BY 4.0 (commercial use allowed), but the dataset's own notes say 'exclusively for research purposes. Commercial purposes are fully excluded.' Both are recorded; the dataset-specific restriction is the stricter reading and should be confirmed with legal before use in the client's warning service.

MISSING-VALUE CODING: -200 is the missing marker. Sample counts: CO(GT) 1592 rows (17% of rows missing), NMHC(GT) 8443 (90% missing), NOx(GT) 1639, NO2(GT) 1642, sensor columns and T/RH/AH 366 each. The UCI variables table says 'Missing values: no' for every column and the declared flag says has_missing_values 'no' in the metadata, but the UCI page itself says 'Has Missing Values? Yes'.

SENTINEL NOT CAUGHT BY PROFILER: C6H6(GT) reports non_missing_share 1.0 and no -200 sentinel count, yet it has 366 negative values with minimum -200.0. The same 366 rows are likely missing, so benzene is effectively missing for about 3.9% of rows unless -200 is recoded.

DATE FORMAT CONFLICT: UCI documents Date as DD/MM/YYYY, but the file parses as M/D/YYYY (sample min 3/10/2004 = 2004-03-10, max 4/4/2005 = 2005-04-04). Treat the file as month-first unless confirmed by the owner.

PERIOD CONFLICT: UCI text says recordings run 'March 2004 to February 2005 (one year)'. The whole file (sample_is_whole_file = true, 9,357 rows) runs to 2005-04-04. Records dated after February 2005 exist, so the documented period is incomplete. Count mismatch: 9,357 rows in file vs 9,358 instances stated.
The sample covers the whole file, so the date range above is the full file range, not just a sample range.
Negative temperature values exist (T: 13 negative values, minimum -1.9 C); these are plausible winter readings, not sentinels. CO(GT) has 91 negative values, all of them -200 sentinels.
Sensor columns (PT08.*) are typed 'Categorical' in UCI metadata but are integers in the file; the data profile treats them as integer.
Time values are written HH:00:00 in the file, while the UCI documentation says HH.MM.SS.

Known drift and cross-sensitivity in the sensor columns are documented by UCI (citing De Vito et al. 2008). The sensor responses are not calibrated concentrations for a monitoring service; only the reference columns (GT) are ground truth.
Dataset is hourly from a single road-level device, with no traffic counts, no station identifier and no city name. It does not cover N2 (traffic), N4/N5 (clinic data) or N6 (national deaths).
sample_findings: Date: parsed as %m/%d/%Y, 391 distinct days, range 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04, no unparsed values; documented as DD/MM/YYYY (conflict).
Time: 24 distinct hourly values, format HH:00:00, no missing.
CO(GT): 17% missing (-200 coded, 1592 rows); 91 negative values, all -200 sentinels; max 11.9 mg/m^3.
NMHC(GT): 90% missing (-200 coded, 8443 rows); range 7 to 1189 among valid values.
C6H6(GT): no sentinel counted by profiler, but 366 negative values with minimum -200.0 (sentinel not flagged).
NOx(GT): 17.5% valid share, -200 coded 1639 rows; NO2(GT): -200 coded 1642 rows; both non-negative otherwise (NO2 max 340 ug/m^3).
PT08.S1..S5 and AH: 366 rows (3.9%) coded -200; no zeros or negatives otherwise.
T: 13 negative values (min -1.9 C) that are real temperatures, plus 366 -200 sentinels; max 44.6 C.
No personal-looking columns (pii_suspected false for all columns).
unknowns: Name of the Italian city and the exact monitoring location are not stated in any source read.
Whether the data owner (Saverio Vito / UCI donor) permits use for a public-health warning service; the research-only note and the CC BY 4.0 claim conflict.
Whether a licence or consent statement exists beyond the UCI page; the zip (static/public/360/air+quality.zip) was not opened.
Why the file runs past February 2005 (to 2005-04-04) when the documentation says February 2005.
Whether -200 in C6H6(GT) is intended as missing, given the profiler did not flag it.
Exact date format (DD/MM vs MM/DD) as stated by the data owner.
Reference-analyzer method, calibration and the station's exact coordinates are not documented.
Whether any traffic, humidity or clinic data exists for this city in the same period (not covered by this source).

provenance.claim: UCI 360 is a 9,358-instance hourly multisensor dataset from an unnamed Italian city, with 15 features, DOI 10.24432/C59K5F, creator Saverio Vito, and a data_url at static/public/360/data.csv.
The CSV is the whole file: 9,357 rows, 15 columns, 741,211 bytes, date range 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04, -200 used as the missing marker.
CC BY 4.0 licence block and the dataset's research-only restriction ('Commercial purposes are fully excluded') both appear on the UCI page.
Dataset notes say recordings ran March 2004 to February 2005, and -200 marks missing values; the metadata says has_missing_values 'no' while the page says 'Has Missing Values? Yes'.
